_contract: Every content file is named with its sha256; a reader proves the bytes through aadistill.evaluation.eval_registry.require_intact before reading. Items, gold answers, weights, scoring semantics (the conformance vectors) and identity change only through a new identity in data/eval-set/registry.json citing a maintainer authorization; new evaluation needs become eval-set-2, never a rewrite of this set.

stage3_capability_846/battery_v2/knowled.reason: TriviaQA: the dataset card's license is 'unknown' and states the University of Washington does not own the copyright of the questions; no basis to redistribute in a public repository without maintainer/legal review

weights: none: every unit is reported separately and no cross-unit or cross-capability aggregate is defined; a composite would need a new identity

fluid_reasoning_720.description: project-generated procedural reasoning tasks over five axes, drawn only from evaluation-split rule families and evaluation-only generators; static items are single-turn, interactive items are episodes stepped by a deterministic environment

scorer.rule: static: correct = usable_rollout AND canonical(last \boxed{} of the final answer) == canonical(gold) by answer_type; interactive: correct = the environment's own success, re-derived by replaying the recorded final answers through a fresh environment; v2: the reply's boxed answer and the gold are canonicalized by tasks.common.CANON_V2 (Unicode minus, LaTeX wrappers, letter-spaced words, per-token \mathrm{}, comma-separated grid rows, a trailing parenthetical after a name, \emptyset / nobody / 'no knights' for an empty set), a superset of v1

generation_protocol.allowance: per sample: supported context - rendered prompt (P18)
generation_protocol.context: the model's actual supported context; a recovered student at its trained context, a reference model at its configured context
generation_protocol.action_protocol: v2 for formal measurement (tasks.interactive: markdown emphasis, code spans, $ and spaced/comma code digits read as the action); the environment and the replay use the SAME protocol, recorded per episode. Historical episodes are v1.
